notes: «قال كتب نجدة إلى ابن عباس يسأله» is scene: Najda is the asker inside the story, not a link; the route runs to Yazid b. Hormoz, who wrote Ibn Abbas's letter, and Ibn Abbas, whose words the letter carries
«- وهو ابن هارون -» is an editor gloss and is left out
Ibn Abbas's occurrence is the second, in «كتبت كتاب ابن عباس إلى نجدة»
